# Tomorrow Night 80s

Tomorrow Night 80s for Antares: the code editor theme ported from the Ace editor, with a matching interface.

## Install

Download [theme.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/antares-sql/themes/main/themes/tomorrow-night-eighties/theme.json), then in Antares open **Settings → Themes → Import from file**.
